name: mergeworthy
description: Work with an AI coding agent through GitHub like a coworker: merge-ready PRs, every thread answered, every post reviewed, minimal supervision.

badge.title: Agent badge on posts
badge.description: on: every post starts with the agent's icon and label; off: never; auto: only when posting from a human account

merge.title: Who merges
merge.description: on-request-squash: the agent squash-merges when asked; reviewer: the agent never merges

watcher.title: GitHub watcher
watcher.description: on: threads you work in are watched and new comments wake the agent; off: no watcher
